attributes.description: Golden-signal view of one Cloud SQL for MySQL instance. Entry point: [GCP OTel] Cloud SQL MySQL Overview.

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "< Back to overview"
ROW `Open` = "< Back to overview"

embeddableConfig.description: Returns to the Cloud SQL MySQL overview, carrying the current time range.
Name of the Cloud SQL for MySQL instance selected by the current filter.
esql_query:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database" AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS marker = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`metrics.cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY database_id
| WHERE marker > 0
| EVAL instance = SUBSTRING(database_id, LOCATE(database_id, ":") + 1)
| KEEP instance
| LIMIT 1
embeddableConfig.template:
{% if rows.size == 0 %}
No instance matches the current filters.
{% else %} {% for row in rows %}
{{ row["instance"].value }}
{% endfor %} {% endif %}

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS total = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)), samples = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE samples > 0
| EVAL queries_per_sec = TO_DOUBLE(total) / (samples * 60)
| KEEP bucket, queries_per_sec

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_mysql.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS total = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)), samples = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(cloudsql.googleapis.`com/database/mysql/queries`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE samples > 0
| EVAL queries_per_sec = TO_DOUBLE(total) / (samples * 60)
| KEEP bucket, queries_per_sec

embeddableConfig.title: Queries per second
embeddableConfig.description: Statements executed per second, from one-minute delta counts of database/mysql/queries divided by the minutes reported in each bucket. A sudden drop with flat CPU usually means clients cannot connect.

embeddableConfig.title: Replica lag
embeddableConfig.description: Average number of seconds this read replica is behind its primary in each time bucket. Only read replicas report replica lag, so the chart is empty for other instances. Near zero is healthy; a steady climb means reads from the replica are increasingly stale.
